title: Mirabel and the Orbit
author: M. M. Eastwick
blurb: Edmund Voss, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
